Static for Chumby One
=====================

A radio made of podcasts (https://staticradio.app), for the Chumby One.

Set up
------
1. Make sure the chumby is already on Wi-Fi (use the stock chumby screens).
2. Copy everything in this zip onto the root of a FAT32 USB stick:
   userhook1, README.txt and the static folder.
3. Plug the stick into the chumby and restart it (unplug the power, plug it
   back in). Static replaces the stock screens about a minute into the boot.

That runs Static from the stick and changes nothing on the chumby.

To keep it: hold the top button until the menu opens, tap
"Install on this chumby", then take the stick out. Static then starts at every
boot and updates itself.

Using it
--------
Turn the knob        change stations (or tap a station name)
Top button + knob    volume
Speaker glyph        mute
Heart                save the show to your faves
Hold the top button  menu: chumby settings (Wi-Fi, time zone), install,
                     updates, and "Turn off Static" to go back to stock

More: https://github.com/madewith-bestpractice/static-chumby
